title.en: Excavator illustrates the note on Diesel 30 vs Tractor-Driven 4100
title.zh: 「挖掘机」用来说明柴油30和拖拉机带动4100有何不同

description.en: Diesel 30 vs Tractor-Driven 4100. 56 kW stays in the catalogue entry. Illustration: Excavator.
description.zh: 柴油30和拖拉机带动4100有何不同。56 kW仍在目录格子里。插图来自「挖掘机」。

h1.en: Excavator illustrates the note on Diesel 30 vs Tractor-Driven 4100
h1.zh: 「挖掘机」用来说明柴油30和拖拉机带动4100有何不同

directAnswer.en: Diesel 30 and the Tractor-Driven 4100 are concrete pumps from Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai. Diesel 30 lists 4105 / 56 kW, 15 m³/h, 20 MPa and distance 60 m / 180 m. The picture is from https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Excavator.
directAnswer.zh: 柴油30和拖拉机带动4100是河北品锦机械在邢台的混凝土泵。柴油30标出 4105 / 56 kW、15 m³/h、20 MPa、距离 60 m / 180 m。图片来自https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Excavator。

body.en: Downloaded from https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Excavator. The image subject is Excavator. Diesel 30 and the Tractor-Driven 4100 are concrete pumps from Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai. The other is a range. Dimensions: Diesel 30 lists 4000 × 1500 × 1800 mm. Tractor-Driven 4100 lists 2900 × 1000 × 1350 mm. Tractor-Driven 4100 lists entries that Diesel 30 does not: Power 40 kW. Pumping pressure 15 MPa. Conveying distance (H / V) 40–100 m / 15–45 m. Concrete slump 180–220 mm. Total weight 1300 kg. Hebei Pinjin Machinery builds these concrete pumps in Xingtai, Hebei.
body.zh: 此图下载自https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Excavator。画面内容是Excavator。柴油30和拖拉机带动4100是河北品锦机械在邢台的混凝土泵。料斗容积：柴油30标出 0.3 m³；拖拉机带动4100标出 0.25 m³。柴油30有、拖拉机带动4100没有的行：柴油机功率 4105 / 56 kW；最大出口压力 20 MPa；输送距离（水平/垂直） 60 m / 180 m；整机重量 2000 kg。商品名里的数字不能用来抄产量、压力或距离。

body.en: Diesel 30 lists 4105 / 56 kW, 15 m³/h, 20 MPa and distance 60 m / 180 m. Theoretical output: Diesel 30 lists 15 m³/h. Tractor-Driven 4100 lists 6–12 m³/h. These are shown entries on the Hebei Pinjin Machinery pages for concrete pumps made in Xingtai. A blank or missing label is not filled from the other concrete pump. The number in a commercial name is not a licence to copy output, pressure or distance.
body.zh: 柴油30标出 4105 / 56 kW、15 m³/h、20 MPa、距离 60 m / 180 m。最大骨料粒径：柴油30标出 3 cm and below；拖拉机带动4100标出 1–3 cm。拖拉机带动4100有、柴油30没有的行：功率 40 kW；泵送压力 15 MPa；输送距离（水平/垂直） 40–100 m / 15–45 m；坍落度 180–220 mm；整机重量 1300 kg。如果工况需要这对机型没有写出的数字，请走联系页，不要编造缸径、行程或价格。

body.en: The tractor lists 40 kW, 6–12 m³/h, 15 MPa, distance 40–100 m / 15–45 m and the only slump entry in the pump tables, 180–220 mm. Hopper capacity: Diesel 30 lists 0.3 m³. Tractor-Driven 4100 lists 0.25 m³. They are not a calculated conversion from one model to the other. The tractor power line does not say 4105, and Diesel 30 does not list slump. If a job needs a figure this pair does not list, use the contact page rather than inventing a bore, stroke or price.
body.zh: 拖拉机标出 40 kW、6–12 m³/h、15 MPa、距离 40–100 m / 15–45 m，以及泵表里唯一的坍落度格 180–220 mm。外形尺寸：柴油30标出 4000 × 1500 × 1800 mm；拖拉机带动4100标出 2900 × 1000 × 1350 mm。拖拉机的功率行没有写 4105，柴油30也没有标出坍落度。

body.en: One distance is a single pair. Max. aggregate size: Diesel 30 lists 3 cm and below. Tractor-Driven 4100 lists 1–3 cm. Diesel 30 lists entries that Tractor-Driven 4100 does not: Diesel engine power 4105 / 56 kW. Max. outlet pressure 20 MPa. Pumping distance (H / V) 60 m / 180 m. Main unit weight 2000 kg. Open /en/products/diesel-30-concrete-pump/ for Diesel 30 and /en/products/tractor-4100-concrete-pump/ for Tractor-Driven 4100.
body.zh: 理论输送量：柴油30标出 15 m³/h；拖拉机带动4100标出 6–12 m³/h。以上是河北品锦机械在邢台混凝土泵页面上写出的格子，不是把一台机器换算成另一台。看柴油30请打开 /zh/products/diesel-30-concrete-pump/，看拖拉机带动4100请打开 /zh/products/tractor-4100-concrete-pump/。

question.en: Does Diesel 30 list the same theoretical output as Tractor-Driven 4100?
question.zh: 柴油30和拖拉机带动4100的理论输送量一样吗？

answer.en: No. Diesel 30 lists 15 m³/h. Tractor-Driven 4100 lists 6–12 m³/h. Both are Hebei Pinjin Machinery catalogue entries from Xingtai, and neither entry replaces the other. It is not a figure printed inside https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Excavator.
answer.zh: 不一样。柴油30标出 15 m³/h。拖拉机带动4100标出 6–12 m³/h。两格都是河北品锦机械在邢台公布的目录，不能互相替代。它不是https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Excavator画面里印出的数字。

question.en: Does Diesel 30 list the same hopper capacity as Tractor-Driven 4100?
question.zh: 柴油30和拖拉机带动4100的料斗容积一样吗？

answer.en: No. Diesel 30 lists 0.3 m³. Tractor-Driven 4100 lists 0.25 m³. Both are Hebei Pinjin Machinery catalogue entries from Xingtai, and neither entry replaces the other. It is not a figure printed inside https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Excavator.
answer.zh: 不一样。柴油30标出 0.3 m³。拖拉机带动4100标出 0.25 m³。两格都是河北品锦机械在邢台公布的目录，不能互相替代。它不是https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Excavator画面里印出的数字。

question.en: Does Diesel 30 list the same max. aggregate size as Tractor-Driven 4100?
question.zh: 柴油30和拖拉机带动4100的最大骨料粒径一样吗？

answer.en: No. Diesel 30 lists 3 cm and below. Tractor-Driven 4100 lists 1–3 cm. Both are Hebei Pinjin Machinery catalogue entries from Xingtai, and neither entry replaces the other. It is not a figure printed inside https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Excavator.
answer.zh: 不一样。柴油30标出 3 cm and below。拖拉机带动4100标出 1–3 cm。两格都是河北品锦机械在邢台公布的目录，不能互相替代。它不是https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Excavator画面里印出的数字。

question.en: On this row: Why is diesel engine power missing on Tractor-Driven 4100?
question.zh: 为什么拖拉机带动4100没有柴油机功率？

answer.en: The Tractor-Driven 4100 page does not list that label. Diesel 30 lists 4105 / 56 kW. Leave the missing entry blank. Hebei Pinjin Machinery does not publish a rule for copying it across concrete pumps. It is not a figure printed inside https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Excavator.
answer.zh: 拖拉机带动4100这一页没有标出这个标题。柴油30标出的是 4105 / 56 kW。缺的格子保持空白。河北品锦机械没有公布把该格抄到另一台混凝土泵上的规则。它不是https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Excavator画面里印出的数字。
